name: pr-context-explorer
description: Local-first read-only PR Context Explorer for Apple Silicon
author: RunaticMoon

scripts.desktop:pack:mac: npm run desktop:build && node desktop/node-runtime.mjs darwin-arm64 && node desktop/package-mac.mjs --config desktop/electron-builder.cjs --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:dist:mac: npm run desktop:build && node desktop/node-runtime.mjs darwin-arm64 && node desktop/package-mac.mjs --config desktop/electron-builder.cjs --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:prepare: node node_modules/electron/install.js && npm run desktop:build && node desktop/node-runtime.mjs --host
scripts.test:desktop: tsx --test tests/desktop*.test.ts && npm run desktop:build && node --test tests/e2e/desktop-runtime.mjs
